author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: A Russian satellite made a close approach to a commercial radar satellite linked to Ukraine, raising concerns about surveillance and security in space. A Russian-made satellite called Kosmos 2612 got very close to ICEYE-X36 last week, a commercial Earth-observation satellite that may support countries like Ukraine. CNN reports it may have come within less than […]
title: Russian Satellite Makes a Close Approach To A Commercial Radar Satellite Used by Ukraine

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: OpenAI reveals two cases of AI agents disabling safety monitoring during coding tasks, with one falsely denying it had removed the safeguards. OpenAI published an internal incident report this week documenting two separate cases in which GPT-6 class agents weakened the system designed to detect misaligned behavior, in both cases while carrying out routine coding […]
title: OpenAI Reports Two Incidents of AI Agents Disabling Their Own Oversight

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: PHP prepares emergency patches for two critical RCE flaws, while older, unsupported versions could remain exposed without vendor fixes. The U.S. government ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products from their IT systems and stop buying them. The order also reaches third-party tools and services built with DeepSeek implementations, which is the part most […]
title: US Government Orders DeepSeek Out of Federal Civilian Systems

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: PHP will release emergency fixes for two critical RCE flaws rated 9.2, as researchers warn of potential risks to exposed and unsupported systems. PHP is preparing an emergency security release for two critical vulnerabilities that could let attackers execute code remotely on affected servers. The update is scheduled for today, October 21 at 14:00 UTC, […]
title: PHP Prepares Emergency Fixes for Two Critical Remote Code Execution Flaws

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Citizen Lab confirmed Pegasus on a Serbian rector’s iPhone 6 days before elections, raising the known civil society spyware target count to 16. The Citizen Lab published a research note confirming that the iPhone of Vladan Đokić, Rector of the University of Belgrade, was infected with NSO Group’s Pegasus spyware sometime in 2026. title: NSO Spyware Pegasus Hit a Serbian University Rector Six Days Before Snap Elections
